mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `fave`.notifications (user_email, message, url, is_read, is_deleted, created_at) VALUES (#{userEmail}, #{message}, #{url}, #{isRead}, #{isDeleted}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT `index`, user_email AS `userEmail`, message, url, `is_read` AS `isRead`, `is_deleted` AS `isDeleted`, `created_at` AS `createdAt` FROM `fave`.notifications WHERE `index` = #{index}

SELECT `index`, user_email AS `userEmail`, message, url, `is_read` AS `isRead`, `is_deleted` AS `isDeleted`, `created_at` AS `createdAt` FROM `fave`.notifications WHERE `user_email` = #{userEmail} AND `is_deleted` = FALSE ORDER BY `index` DESC
